title: Writer
summary: WRITER, noun 1. One who writes or has written. 2. An author. 3. A clerk or amanuensis. WRITER of the tallies, an officer of the exchequer of England; a clerk to the auditor of the receipt, who writes

inlines.v: WRITER, noun 1. One who writes or has written. 2. An author. 3. A clerk or amanuensis. WRITER of the tallies, an officer of the exchequer of England; a clerk to the auditor of the receipt, who writes upon the tallies the whole of the tellers bills.
